text.p: Albania's government annulled its suspensions of several Albanian soccer federation officials in an attempt to get the country reinstated into international soccer, the Albanian news agency ATA reported on Monday.

World soccer's governing body FIFA suspended Albania indefinitely after the sports ministry ordered the suspension of Albanian Football Association (AFA) general secretary Eduard Dervishi and dissolved its executive committee.
The ban had jeopardized Albania's World Cup group nine qualifying match against Northern Ireland on December 14.
Albanian sports secretary Marjeta Pronjari said Dervishi had broken the country's civil law by consistently postponing new executive committee elections and he had therefore been suspended.
FIFA, however, did not recognise the suspensions and still considered Dervishi and the dissolved executive as their only official contacts in Albania.
Albanian Prime Minister Aleksander Meksi on Sunday appealed to his country's soccer federation and the state sports secretariat to settle their dispute.
He had also recommended that new executive committee elections be held in February.
